.²1 Seizing, holding, taking, grasping; {#Asanarajjuparigrahe#}
 <ls>R. 9. 46</ls>; {#SaNkAparigrahaH#} <ls>Mu. 1</ls>
 ‘taking or entertaining a doubt’.
.²2 Surrounding, enclosing, encircling, fencing round.

 <ls>Māl. 1</ls>; so {#AsanaparigrahaM karotu devaH#} <ls>U. 3</ls> ‘your majesty will be
 pleased to take a seat or sit down’.
